svg.title: Enterprise Voice Agent Long-Call Audio Context Pruning & PTU/PAYGO Elastic FinOps Architecture (Stage 374 · P741–P742)
svg.desc: Visual comparison of quadratic O(N^2) raw audio token billing explosion vs P741 4-turn sliding audio window + slot-pinned text compaction (-74% cost) and P742 Erlang-C PTU baseload reservation (50–82%) + PAYGO burst spillover.
svg.text: STAGE 374 · TOPIC 14 · P741–P742
Long-Call Audio Context Pruning & PTU/PAYGO Elastic FinOps
长通话音频 Token 爆炸与 FinOps 成本治理选型：4 轮音频滑窗+结构化槽位压缩 (P741) 与 Erlang-C PTU+PAYGO 弹性溢出 (P742)
① P741: 4-Turn Sliding Audio Window & Slot-Pinned Text Compaction
⛔ Legacy Unbounded Audio Context (O(N²) Quadratic Billing Explosion)
• Native S2S encodes audio at ~25–50 tokens/sec (~1,500–3,000 audio tokens/min)
• Every new turn re-sends ALL prior raw audio turns: Turn 20 re-bills Minutes 1..11!
• Result: 12-min call costs $0.2244/min (3.8x spike) & KV-cache latency bloats >780ms!
Physics: Raw audio tokens are 10x–15x denser and more expensive than equivalent text tokens
✅ P741: 4-Turn Raw Audio Window + Pinned Slot JSON + 80% Prefix Cache
1. Keep Only Last 4 Turns as Raw Audio (Turns k-3..k): Preserves immediate emotional
prosody, sigh/hesitation cues, and acoustic context where it actually matters
2. Evict Older Audio -> Compact to Text + Pinned Slot JSON (Turns 1..k-4):
10:1 token compression while pinning {verifiedId, flightNo, confirmedAmount} at top
3. Immutable Prefix Cache Alignment (>=80% hit rate): Cuts 12-min S2S cost from
$0.2244/min down to $0.0584/min (-74.0% savings!) with zero slot amnesia
P741 Offline Policy Check: 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution;
actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic)
② P742: Erlang-C PTU Baseload Reservation & PAYGO Burst Spillover
FinOps Capacity & Billing Selection Matrix
• Model A: 100% PAYGO (Pay-As-You-Go) — Best for <50k min/mo PoCs; vulnerable to peak HTTP 429
• Model B: 100% PTU Sized for 10x Peak — Wastes 70%+ idle capacity at night (2.3x overpay)
• Model C: Erlang-C Hybrid PTU Baseload (50–82%) + PAYGO Burst Spillover (P742)
Size PTU for P65–P75 steady traffic (~54% avg util crossover); overflow bursts to PAYGO
or Phi4-mm-realtime ($0.048/min) when PTU utilization exceeds 85%
✅ P742: Golden 54% PTU Break-Even & Zero-429 Spillover Router
• Break-Even Physics: Reserved PTU becomes cheaper than PAYGO once average
24x7 utilization exceeds ~54.0% (clamped target band: 50%–82% steady utilization)
• Real-Time Token Bucket Spillover (>85% PTU load): Automatically overflows excess
concurrent calls to PAYGO or Hybrid Semantic VAD lane without dropping a single call
• Per-Call Wallet Ceiling: Hard circuit-breaker against infinite loop / bot drain
P742 Offline Policy Check: 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution;
actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic)
PROVENANCE & MEASUREMENT BOUNDARY DISCLOSURE (STAGE 374 · DIMENSION 377)
• Offline Policy State Machine (P741/P742): 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution; actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic).
• FinOps Cost Model: $0.2244/min -> $0.0584/min (-74.0%) and 54.0% PTU break-even are analytical FinOps calculations from published retail token pricing.
